verified_contract.stiffness_map: K'=A K A^T; independently reassemble K'
verified_contract.force_map: f'=A f for co-transformed surface loads and scalar measures
verified_contract.centered_gauge_map: B=diag(Q,Q); C'=B C A^T; g'=B g; physical lambda'=B lambda, with r=x-c and c'=Qc+t

voigt.rotation_rule: convert strain/stress to symmetric tensors, rotate with Q T Q^T, then convert using the distinct engineering-strain and stress conventions

verified_contract.local_frame: H'=QH and o'=Qo+t imply crack-local xi=H^T(x-o) is invariant; branch values stay fixed and world gradients rotate by Q
verified_contract.mls_parameters: transform reference_origin; keep reference_scale, support_radius, R, L and material scalars unchanged under rigid motion
verified_contract.quadrature: rotate volume and surface positions/normals; keep scalar measures unchanged

findings.evidence: Cached _branch_values forwards world x,y to branch_functions_local; cached _reference calls evaluate_local_point with the supplied xyz. Those calls rely on the identity crack frame.
findings.required_design_change: Evaluate branches from transformed local coordinates relative to the crack origin/tip, map local gradients through H', and construct the field with CrackFrame/evaluate_point so reported vectors and tensors are world-frame values.

findings.evidence: _physical_moment_matrix sets center to zero and uses relative=xyz; _direct_physical_moments uses cross(xyz,u).
findings.required_design_change: Use r=x-c in both matrix and direct moments, with c'=Qc+t, or add an explicit center parameter. Record the selected center.

findings.evidence: The design requests force/moment wrench covariance without naming the moment point or translation term.
findings.required_design_change: State F'=QF and either M_c'=Q M_c about a co-transformed center or M_0'=Q M_0+t cross F' about the global origin; scale the residual robustly when the net wrench nearly cancels.

findings.evidence: mixed_enriched_operator.py exposes public raw stiffness and force assembly over supplied semantic rows; the cached solver's moment/reconstruction/KKT routines are private. Neither is an end-to-end transformed solver.
findings.required_design_change: Revise the interface inventory to identify reusable public raw K/f operations and private moment/field/solve helpers accurately; state the missing frame-aware row construction and orchestration boundary.

findings.evidence: The draft separates source-cloud rotation from tetrahedral mesh direction runs, but tetra remeshing changes basis and integration together; co-rotating existing quadrature tests coordinate covariance only.
findings.required_design_change: Add a separate quadrature-rule/orientation sensitivity design holding physical geometry and basis/cloud fixed, or declare the integration effect intentionally unresolved.

findings.evidence: Counts are arithmetically consistent, but no K-rotation timing, output schema, memory trace, or conditioning study supports the 30 s/8 MiB/64 MiB caps or proposed errors.
findings.required_design_change: Keep these as provisional targets, define retained evidence and memory scope, use dimensional/backward-scaled wrench residuals, and preserve UNKNOWN for unsupported/rank/cap failures.

orientation_studies.coordinate_covariance: Rotate all geometry, sources, quadrature, loads, crack frame, MLS origin, and gauge center together. This is a reparameterization test.
orientation_studies.source_cloud_only: Proposed 0/+37/-23 degree cloud rotations hold the physical state and quadrature fixed; they measure interpolation/source-layout sensitivity.
orientation_studies.quadrature_only: Not currently specified; integration-rule sensitivity must be isolated from cloud and mesh changes.
orientation_studies.tetra_mesh_and_crack_front: Proposed four one-step polyline runs measure local mesh-direction sensitivity; they do not establish a full crack path or surface objectivity.

minimal_source_only_adapter_recommendati: Define a non-mutating rigid-transform/crack-frame facade for point, vector, tensor, MLS-origin, and moment-center maps; evaluate front basis in local coordinates and emit world gradients/fields. No implementation or numeric run was performed.
remaining_limits: The moving-front provider remains an antiplane scalar provider without a mixed93 vector assembly or solver path.
The result is a design review, not measured K-rotation covariance, fracture qualification, mesh-direction resolution, or a numerical acceptance claim.
